row:
Hello brothers and sisters, I'm Agelina Animals RescueAnd Sanctuary.
We are in a very difficult situation. Right now, we are caring for 99 dogs and 36 cats, and we continue rescuing animals from the streets whenever we can. Some of them are sick, and all of them depend on us for food, clean water, medical treatment, and love.
The expenses have become overwhelming. Rent, daily food, and constant vet bills are more than I can manage alone, and I am struggling to keep up.
That is why I am reaching out for help. We are trying to raise $21,000 to give these dogs and cats a chance at life—to keep them fed, treated, and safe.
If you can spare even a small donation, it would mean so much. If you are unable to donate, please consider sharing our GoFundMe with your friends and family. Every share helps.
Together, we can make a difference and give these innocent lives a second chance 🐾
